title: Second Meals Kept on a Giving School Nutrition Services Meal Account in a Sibling Netting
content:
The keep of a sibling netting between School Nutrition Services Meal Accounts counts a second meal by how many times it was rung up on the account in the month before the netting date: four (4) or more purchases make a regular buyer, and the second-meal price is added to every serving day counted; one to three purchases add once what the student spent on it in that month; no purchase adds nothing.

A date falls within the N months before the netting date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the netting date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

| Times a second meal was rung up in the month before the netting date | What is added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | the second-meal price (4.25) for every serving day counted |
| 1, 2 or 3 | what the student spent on it in that month, once |
| 0 | nothing |

### Input, judgement, result (hypothetical)

Input: a second meal rung up on six days of the month before the netting date. Judgement: six is four or more, a regular buyer. Result: 4.25 for every serving day counted.

Input: rung up twice, for a total spent of 8.50. Judgement: one to three purchases. Result: 8.50, added once.
